notes: UI overhaul: admin and tech now see exactly what they should. Tech roster moved behind the admin console (it was open to everyone). New Admin console layout — team tools first, diagnostics last, plus a Cloud sync status card and an always-visible Admin console door on the admin's Profile. Check-in screens stop saying 'checkout'. 'Set up' is now called the same thing everywhere. Help & tour rewritten to match how the app actually works today.
